sentences.text: The learned Assistant Government Pleader for Revenue takes notice on behalf of respondent Nos.1 to 4.

The learned counsel for the petitioners is permitted to take out personal notice to respondent Nos.5 and 6 through registered post with acknowledgment due and file proof of service in the Registry by the next date of hearing.

The learned counsel for the petitioners contends that the respondent authorities, without issuing any notice to the petitioners and without affording them an opportunity of hearing, have mutated the names of respondent Nos.5 and 6 in the revenue records in respect of the subject property belonging to the petitioners.

Such action is arbitrary, illegal, and violative of the principles of natural Justice, and is in direct contravention of the law laid down by the Full Bench of the erstwhile High Court of Andhra Pradesh in i Chinnam Pandurangam vs Mandal Revenue Officer, Serilingampally Mandal and Others, reported in 2007 (6) ALD 348.

entities.text: Chinnam Pandurangam vs Mandal Revenue Officer, Serilingampally Mandal and Others, reported in 2007 (6) ALD 348
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Aggrieved by the said action of the respondents, the petitioners preferred an appeal/representation before the 2 nd respondent on 20.11.2025.

Instead of considering the said appeal/representation^
conducting an appropriate enquiry, and taking necessary action ii n accordance with law, the respondents issued the impugned endorsement dated 08.12.2025 rejecting the case of the petitioners.

Even upon a perusal of the impugned endorsement and the references relied upon therein, it is evident that no notice was issued to the petitioners nor was any opportunity of hearing afforded to them before arriving at such conclusion.

Considering the submissions made by the learned counsel for the petitioners and r upon perusal of the impugned endorsement dated 08.12.2025, there shall be an interim direction to both the parties to maintain status quo as obtaining as on today with regard to the revenue records.
List the matter after four (4) weeks.
In the meanwhile, the learned Assistant Government Pleader for Revenue is directed to file a counter affidavit.
